description: Find properties near coordinates (reverse geocoding). Billed per field, per home returned. Required: latitude, longitude. Optional: radius (km), shape (circle/square). This endpoint has no country, province, city, community or address parameters. To narrow by place, put filters such as country_abbreviation_eq=CA or city_eq=Calgary in filters, spelled exactly as location_endpoint returns them, letter case included. With no such filter the point and radius may cover no more homes than one country holds, and a filter that names more than one country is refused with a 400. For active or marketable properties, add has_expand_listings_eq=true to filters, which is far cheaper than expanding listings just to filter on their presence.

exclude.description: Source classes to leave out, comma separated, such as "inferred" or "inferred,observed". Checks the selected fields that have a source column, keeps a property when one of them keeps its value, and empties the rest.

expand.description: Comma-separated. Values: "listings", "listings_rent", "permits", "assessments". Each attached record is a flat charge. To filter to properties that HAVE a set, use the has_expand_* boolean filters instead.

filter_expand_match.description: "any" or "all". Use only when filtering on values inside expanded records.

filters.description: Filters array. Format: "field_operator=value", with the value as plain text and not URL encoded. Use search_api_documentation for reference.

price_quote.description: Return the cost of this request without billing it or returning data

name: geocoding_endpoint
